_instructions: Assessments keyed by ticker. Required for qualification: probabilityLow, probabilityHigh (YES probability in percent), sourceUrl, reviewedAt, validUntil, modelValidated:true, rulesVerified:true, entryFeeCentsPerContract, exitFeeCentsPerContract, maxExecutableContracts. Optional swing: sourceUrl, catalyst, catalystAt, invalidation, targetCents, downsideCents, holdingDays. Evidence and execution assumptions must be verified externally; this app does not validate supplied claims.
